facts.raw_span: 63-year-old man
8-month history of painless scrotal swelling
bilateral testicular enlargement without tenderness
large, solid masses in both testes
Serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin, α-fetoprotein, and lactate dehydrogenase were all within normal limits
no evidence of lymphadenopathy or extranodal lymphomatous masses
7.0 × 6.0 × 4.2 cm tumor confined to the testis with lymphovascular invasion
pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types: small cells, medium cells, and large cells

concepts.why: The presence of a large, solid mass in the testis and a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types supports this diagnosis
The presence of a large, solid mass in the testis and a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types, including small cells, supports this diagnosis
The presence of a large, solid mass in the testis and elevated lactate dehydrogenase levels, although not explicitly stated, could support this diagnosis
The presence of a large, solid mass in the testis and the patient's age could support this diagnosis
The presence of a large, solid mass in the testis and a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types supports this diagnosis

The lack of evidence of lymphadenopathy or extranodal lymphomatous masses on the positron emission tomography–computed tomography scan rules out lymphoma as a primary diagnosis but the presence of lymphovascular invasion in the tumor specimen suggests a possible secondary involvement.

rationales.F04: Bilateral testicular enlargement with large solid masses is more typical of testicular tumors than lymphoma.
rationales.F05: Normal serum tumor markers decrease the likelihood of certain germ cell tumors, such as yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma.
rationales.F06: Absence of lymphadenopathy or extranodal lymphomatous masses makes lymphoma less likely.
rationales.F07: A large tumor confined to the testis with lymphovascular invasion is highly suggestive of a testicular tumor.
rationales.F08: A pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types is characteristic of mixed germ cell tumors.

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types and the lack of elevated serum tumor markers support this diagnosis.
